paragraphs: The Defender Td4 is a rare variant in the UK, fitted to the classic 90/110/130 body style. It uses the BMW M47D20 — a 2.0-litre inline-four diesel unit shared with BMW models of the same era. The M47 is a different engine family from the more common Td5, 300Tdi and 200Tdi diesels found in most classic Defenders, which is why matching by registration is particularly important for this variant. The Defender Td4 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Land Rover Defender Td4 Engine Compatibility Because the Defender Td4 uses the BMW M47D20 — a rare application in the UK Defender range — confirming compatibility before any work is essential. This is a rare application in the UK Defender range, shared with BMW models of the same era rather than Land Rover's own Td5, 300Tdi or 200Tdi diesel family. How much does a Land Rover Defender Td4 engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £1,900. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Do you rebuild BMW M47D20 Defender Td4 engines? Yes. We rebuild the BMW M47D20 to the same standard as our other Defender rebuilds. Do you supply used Defender Td4 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Defender Td4 if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Defender Td4 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Defender Td4 owners, yes. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Defender Td4 from 2023 to present. The BMW M47D20 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older BMW M47D20 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every BMW M47D20 rebuild.
